verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party docs describe real-time webhook push notifications for account events. They also cover delivery semantics: a 200 acknowledgement, stable event IDs for idempotent retry handling, delivery-status inspection, and re-delivery from the web app. The Developer MCP can simulate sandbox events for testing. Missing for 10: documented signature verification and an event-type catalog showing how specific events are selected, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
